_comment: The Fire Magic shape: Tiered. One additional cost chosen from three at cast time, and each tier buys a DIFFERENT effect -- so the card branches on which price was paid. Bitter Triumph (tests/data/modal_cost.cards.json) is the same cost machinery where both prices lead to one effect.
